Liam — great talk this morning. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we have a clean mutual action plan.

Call summary (TL;DR)
- Signal: Orchard expects initial full-traffic pilots for the new assistant starting next month.
- Rough usage profile: ~2.5B tokens / month baseline, with 2–3x growth potential in Q1.
- Key constraint: procurement & PO thresholds will determine the path (SOW vs. PO vs. card).

Pricing signals we discussed
- Target unit economics you called out on the call: target $/1M tokens in the low 20s.
- For our joint modeling, we used these quick bands:
  • Pay-as-you-go (no commit): $24 / 1M tokens (list for planning)
  • Mid commit (6mo, 1–3B/mo): $21 / 1M tokens
  • 12mo committed: $18 / 1M tokens

Estimated monthly cost at 2.5B tokens:
- PAYG @ $24: 2,500 * $24 = $60,000 / month
- 6mo commit @ $21: 2,500 * $21 = $52,500 / month
- 12mo commit @ $18: 2,500 * $18 = $45,000 / month

Procurement thresholds (what we need from you)
- PO required for any vendor spend > $30k / month (you mentioned this on the call).
- Any single-vendor obligation > $50k / month will typically trigger SOW + legal review and slower lead times (3–6 weeks).
- Finance will require a point-of-contact to sign monthly invoice streams for commitments > $40k / month.

Asks / proposed next steps
1) Can you confirm the procurement thresholds above (PO at $30k, SOW at $50k) are accurate for Orchard? If not, share the correct gates.
2) Which pricing path would you prefer us to quote formally (PAYG / 6mo / 12mo)? If you need a blended or ramped structure we can do that too.
3) I'll attach: Orchard usage forecast (your doc) + Redwood pricing brief for internal finance. Please share any internal procurement contact or required contract template.

Attachments: orchard-usage-forecast.xlsx (xlsx), redwood-pricing-brief.pdf (pdf)

If helpful, I'll produce a 1-page mutual action plan (MAP) with dates and owners once you confirm thresholds. Happy to jump on a 15-min sync with finance/procurement this week.

—Naomi

Thanks — confirmed. Below is a compact quote table + implementation notes so your finance/procurement partners have a clear artifact.

Compact quote (monthly cost, 2.5B tokens/month)
- Option A — PAYG (no commit): $24 / 1M => $60,000 / month; invoiced monthly.
- Option B — 6mo committed (1–3B band): $21 / 1M => $52,500 / month; invoiced monthly, paid via PO acceptable; requires basic SOW for > $50k/mo.
- Option C — 12mo committed: $18 / 1M => $45,000 / month; invoiced monthly, PO + standard commitment addendum; legal review expected but we can expedite a short-form SOW.

Notes on procurement mechanics
- PO-only approach: supported for all bands; we can generate monthly invoices referencing a PO number.
- SOW / legal review: will be required for commitments that exceed $50k/mo on average. We can provide a short-form SOW (2–3 pages) to speed review.
- Finance approvals: we can invoice to the billing entity you specify; if finance insists on prepayment for committed discounts, we can provide both monthly and prepay options in the formal quote.

Operational items to surface to finance/procurement
- Estimated ramp profile (attached forecast will help): 2.5B baseline => 2–3x growth if initial pilot runs well.
- SLA expectations: hosted API with multi-region fallback; we can include latency SLAs in the SOW for dedicated capacity (if you need them).
- Data controls: Redwood Private available for regulated data flows — that will change pricing & procurement cadence.

Next steps (proposed)
1) I’ll produce a 1-page quote + MAP (owner names & dates) and a short-form SOW draft. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
2) Schedule a 15–20 min call with your procurement + finance to confirm PO fields and invoice cadence.
3) If you prefer, I’ll include a ramped discount schedule to keep initial spend under $50k while protecting long-term unit economics.

Attaching pricing brief and the forecast we discussed.
